content: macOS BSD vs GNU portability for statuslines: date -d (GNU) vs date -j -f/-v (BSD) differ — avoid both by doing pure epoch arithmetic: now=$(date +%s) is portable; durations formatted with bash integer math (d/h/m from seconds). stat differs: -c %Y (GNU) vs -f %m (BSD); try GNU form first, fallback BSD (macOS stat -c prints garbage? actually Linux stat -f prints fs report to stdout before failing, so GNU-first ordering is required). macOS ships bash 3.2 (no associative arrays, no ${var,,}); use #!/usr/bin/env bash and stick to bash-3.2-safe constructs, or POSIX where easy. printf '%b' preferred over echo -e for escapes across shells.
